glosses: verdünnen (zum Beispiel Säure durch Zusatz von Wasser)

examples.text: Wir diluieren die Lösung, die dadurch auch deutlich blasser wird.

translations.source_sense_description: Medizin: verdünnen (zum Beispiel Säure durch Zusatz von Wasser)

glosses: To make thinner by adding solvent to a solution, especially by adding water.

examples.text: Mix their watery store / With the chyle's current, and dilute it more.

glosses: To weaken, especially by adding a foreign substance.

examples.text: For if these Colours be diluted and weakened by the Mixture of any adventitious light, the distance between the places of the Paper will not be so great.

“Stay a little.”
“Not another second: language and discussion dilute thought; I will say no more.”
It's healthy to have people in the military who would perhaps rather be somewhere else; they can dilute the more gung-ho military types.

glosses: To cause the value of individual shares or the stake of a shareholder to decrease by increasing the total number of shares.
To become attenuated, thin, or weak.

examples.text: Clean the panel with a dilute, neutral cleaner.

glosses: Weak; reduced in strength by dilution; diluted.
Of an animal: having a lighter-coloured coat than is usual.

examples.text: a cat with a dilute tortoiseshell coat

glosses: An animal having a lighter-coloured coat than is usual.

examples.text: On average, blues and other dilutes have weaker coats and skin problems seem more prevalent in the dilutes.

translations.source_sense_description: Medizin: verdünnen (zum Beispiel Säure durch Zusatz von Wasser)

glosses: Étendre d’eau ou d’un solvant adapté, un liquide quelconque.

examples.text: Diluez le pastis dans cinq volumes d’eau !
Les peintures glycérophtaliques se diluent avec du white spirit.

glosses: Rendre moins clair, moins net, moins direct.

examples.text: Plus tard, la peur sera assimilée par le corps, circulera dans le sang, se diluera, deviendra partie prenante de son fonctionnement.
S’il y a un CSPS et un architecte, il devrait se border en faisant en sorte qu’une décision commune soit prise, de manière à diluer les responsabilités en cas d’infection au covid-19.

translations.source_sense_description: Medizin: verdünnen (zum Beispiel Säure durch Zusatz von Wasser)

glosses: aggiungere ad un liquido puro una certa quantità di altro liquido (normalmente acqua) allo scopo di ridurne la purezza o la concentrazione oppure di aumentarne la quantità complessiva. In ambito artistico o pittorico, tipico dello scioglimento del colore nell'acqua o in altra sostanza, detta per questo \"diluente\". Frequentemente utilizzato nelle ricette culinarie.
allungare i contenuti di un testo o di un discorso con elementi di minor pertinenza.

translations.source_sense_description: Medizin: verdünnen (zum Beispiel Säure durch Zusatz von Wasser)

glosses: Poner una sustancia sólida en un líquido que separa o desune sus partes constituyentes.
Agregarle más líquido a una solución.
Volver borrosos los contornos de algo.

examples.text: El paisaje se diluía en la neblina matinal
